IC2: 2) stroke within the past 6 to 60 months,
IC3: 3) major depressive disorder [AND] (PHQ-9 > 10) and diagnosed using the Structured Clinical Interview for Depression (SCID) according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fourth Edition (DSM-IV),
IC4: 4) residual paresis [AND] in the lower extremity (Fugl-Meyer LE motor score <34),
IC5: 5) ability to walk without assistance and [NOT] without an AFO on the treadmill ≥ 30 seconds at speeds ranging from 0.2-0.8 m/s,
IC6: 6) [NOT] no antidepressant [OR] medications or clinically able to discontinue medications,
IC8: 8) provision of informed consent. In addition, all subjects who meet criteria for the training portion must complete an exercise tolerance test and be cleared for participation by the study cardiologist.
